source_scope: git archive of the fixed public commit; production modules unchanged

history.selection: attempts whose instance_id is in paired_tasks; 19 tasks x 5 arms = 95 selected attempts
history.classification: report stop_reason and score.status independently; preserve build/test observations without inferring causes
history.provenance: verify archive SHA256; retain attempt, original attempt, execution source, packaging source, worker and score identities
history.context: one row per metrics.compactions event, with reported count and native log coverage separate
history.usage: provider response input/output tokens, compared with frozen selected-attempt usage; cli-request copies excluded

projection.selection: top six distinct UTF-8 tool-output contents above the byte limit in provider request input arrays of the 95 selected attempts; rank by descending bytes then attempt_id/member/item index; enumerate all requests, preserve any exceptions
projection.transformation: production context.fold_tool_output and EvidenceRef; replace only selected tool output in its original request; context.complete_rounds before/after
projection.provider_tokens: retain original response usage; projected provider usage null; new paid requests zero
projection.interpretation: offline fixed-input volume measurement; no claim of LLM repair or end-to-end token improvement

runtime.backend: real DockerSandbox, public agents.testing.ScriptedModel, no sandbox mocks
runtime.environment: try local Docker then configured Azure host; private directory and dedicated image built from public docker/Dockerfile
runtime.resume: same Run, committed model_input_ready checkpoint, complete native input
runtime.timing: time.perf_counter_ns immediately before resume_run to return of first successfully committed EventLog.emit(model_started); observer delegates unchanged production method
runtime.tokens: synthetic usage, provider tokens null and paid requests zero
runtime.failure_policy: all three registered repetitions retained, including preparation or runtime exceptions; no replacement trials

scenarios.test_tamper: normal source fix plus change protected negative test expectation from -3 to -4
scenarios.regression: normal source fix plus return 0 instead of nullopt for empty input

verification.identity: candidate bytes/SHA256, fixture base commit, task, source commit, image ID, independent evaluation evidence
verification.failure_policy: retain all registered scenarios and exceptions; policy rejection and independent test rejection reported separately

build.action: reuse frozen target_build_profile samples in benchmarks/actions-scale/cloud-results.json; no new build-performance experiment

output_policy: append-only phase directories; source input fingerprints frozen before measurements; actual driver hash on each phase; original results unchanged
